intro: A weekly reading for the Twin Cities — grounded, kind, and written for where you actually live.

horoscopes.text: Energy you usually save for Thursday shows up early. You hear yourself laugh and it sounds easy. Outside, an early haze that burns off by ten. Leave one thing for tomorrow. The world will hold.
The morning tastes like the coffee you made carefully. You decide a thing is good enough and move on with confidence. A pot of tea, a quilt, a closed door.
Today, the small talk is genuinely good. A text thread comes back to life with good news. Somewhere near the line for the Juicy Lucy at Matt's. You did enough. Let the day close.

The right voice on the phone first thing sets the whole day. You say the thing out loud and it loses its weight entirely. Outside, the kind of warmth you don't notice you needed. Open the window an inch. The night air is kind.
Compliments arrive. Receive them gracefully. A meeting you were uncertain about ends with you being thanked. The day was full. Sleep is the best encore.

Order, today, is its own reward and it arrives early. Something you put in place quietly starts paying dividends. Somewhere near an empty Tuesday at Spyhouse. Set the alarm slightly later than you think. You earned it.
You are fair with yourself first thing. The rest of the day follows. You extend grace to yourself for something old and it feels right. A bath, then bed. The ideal sequence.
You arrive somewhere with exactly the perspective the room needs. Something underneath the surface comes up into the light, gently. You carried things well today. Put them down for the night.
You wake up curious about something and it turns out to be worth it. A conversation in line that goes somewhere genuinely good. You went somewhere today, even staying in one place. Sleep well.

You started the year quietly. Today the foundation shows and it is solid. You are reminded why you do the work that does not show. Somewhere near an empty Tuesday at Spyhouse. Set the alarm a little later than usual.
A morning that rewards working alone for an hour first. You are reminded that a strong network is just years of showing up. Quiet now. The work continues tomorrow and it will be good.
You are generous today in a way that feels completely natural. You take the long way home and the river was absolutely the right call. A quiet close to a full and feeling day.
